operators.name: one_hot_float
semantics: Performs one_hot encoding of integer labels x with given num_classes, then casts result to float32.
x is int64 CPU contiguous input; output is on CUDA with same batch, height, width and last dim num_classes.
For each element value v in [0, num_classes-1], output[..., v] = 1.0, all other classes 0.0.
Equivalent to F.one_hot(x.long(), num_classes).float() with device transfer.

operators.name: pad_constant

returns.shape: [batch, height + pad_top + pad_bottom, width + pad_left + pad_right, num_classes]

semantics: Pads the height and width dimensions (dims 1 and 2) with constant value.
Padding order: left, right, top, bottom (matching F.pad 4-tuple).
Output shape: [N, H + pad_top + pad_bottom, W + pad_left + pad_right, C].
Copies input elements to interior; fills boundary regions with value.
Equivalent to F.pad(x, (pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom), mode='constant', value=value).

operators.name: softmax_dim
semantics: Applies softmax along the specified dimension (in this task dim = 1 which is the last dimension after permutation).
Numerically stable: subtract max along dim before exp.
Equivalent to F.softmax(x, dim=dim).

operators.name: one_hot_int64
semantics: Performs one_hot encoding of integer labels x with given num_classes, without float cast.
Output dtype int64 on CUDA.
Used only in debug_forward to reproduce exact int64 checkpoint step_001.

operators.name: cast_float32
semantics: Casts input tensor to float32.
Equivalent to x.float() on CUDA.
Input x int64 CPU with shape [512,128,128].
One-hot encode to shape [512,128,128,5] int64 on CUDA.
Values: 1 at class index, else 0.
Cast int64 one-hot tensor to float32.
Shape unchanged [512,128,128,5] on CUDA.

reference_steps.source: x = F.pad(x, (self.padding_size, self.padding_size, self.padding_size, self.padding_size), value=self.padding_value)
semantics: Pad height and width dims by 2 each using constant value 0.0.
Output shape [512,132,132,9] float32 CUDA.
Interior values copied; padding filled with 0.
Apply softmax over dimension 1 (last dimension after padding, i.e., num_classes=5 but padded to 9).
Since padding adds 4 columns, softmax over 9 values with padded entries zero.
Output shape [512,132,132,9] float32 CUDA.
Return final softmax output.
Shape [512,132,132,9] float32 CUDA.
